definitions.explanation: A public appeal or call to action directed at people, asking them to do something. Also refers to the act of addressing or calling out to someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An appeal was made to the citizens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節電|せつでん}→節電：07136_setsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people responded to the call to save electricity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government continues to urge the public to be cautious.

notes:
Derived from the verb {呼|よ}びかける (to call out to, to appeal to). The noun form refers to a public appeal, call to action, or address.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼|よ}びかけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧: to respond to an appeal
- {呼|よ}びかけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to make an appeal
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ: caution advisory, warning call
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ: call for cooperation
- ⟦{節電|せつでん}→節電：07136_setsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}びかけ: call to save electricity

USAGE:
Very common in news reporting and government communications. Often used when authorities or organizations urge the public to take action (e.g., disaster preparedness, health campaigns, energy conservation).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {呼|よ}びかけ: appeal, call (public, to a group)
- ⟦{訴|うった}え→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: appeal (stronger, emotional or legal)
- ⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧: request (formal, official)
